mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have beautiful, clear skies and a warm 88 degrees that feels like 91 down by Badger Ridge Middle School. Tonight looks perfect for catching a glimpse of the International Space Station passing over at 10:19 PM.

In city news, Verona is making big strides in sustainability. The city is promoting home composting drop-offs at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue, while also offering direct utility rebates for residents who purchase rain barrels or energy-efficient toilets.

Looking ahead to local events, this weekend features live music at Bailey's Run and the Mount Horeb Art Fair on July 18th. Plus, don't miss our very own Verona Downtown Farmer's Market next Wednesday, July 22nd, at Hometown Junction Park.

In police news, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle collision on Friday, July 10th, at the intersection of Old PB and Whalen Road. Fortunately, the bicyclist sustained only minor injuries, and a driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

If you are craving a sweet treat, today's delicious flavor of the day at Culver's is Mint Cookie. They are open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by before tomorrow's Turtle flavor takes over.
